get.description: Requires extensions.read and an exact verified cached catalog identity. Downloads only the selected signed catalog entry through the trusted artifact transport, verifies artifact bytes, archive, manifest and bounded UTF-8 README/CHANGELOG files, then checks the cache identity again. No arbitrary URL is accepted.

200.description: {identity,extensionId,packageVersion,manifest,documents}; documents contains only present bounded package README and CHANGELOG variants.

400.description: Invalid identity, extension ID or query.

404.description: The exact cached catalog or its entry is unavailable.

409.description: Release trust or verified package changed or is unavailable.
